text:
ashwin: Kicking off PDX1 bring-up validation. This thread is the quick smoke + handoff checklist. Ping when each step is done, call out failures.

maria: ack — I'm starting with node provisioning and GPU driver checks. Will validate MIG profiles and NVidia driver versions.

jean: FYI network team already created the interconnect + route filters. I'll test MTU and BGP sessions after nodes are up.

ashwin: Checklist (high level):
- infra: instances up, NTP, node labels/taints set
- gpu: drivers, DCGM, MIG, nv_peer_mem
- k8s: nodeReady, kubelet logs, kube-proxy, cni plugin
- networking: MTU, BGP sessions stable, cross-AZ peer latency < 3ms
- runtime: docker/runc/OCI config, kernel params (hugepages if enabled)
- perf smoke: 10 warmup inferences, 95th latency under SLO, no OOMs
- observability: metrics flowing to TS, tracing enabled, alerting rules in place
- cost gating: initial capacity estimate attached to PR

ashwin: Short commands to run if helpful:
```
# node level
ssh node-01 sudo systemctl status nvidia-docker
sudo nvidia-smi -q | head -n 40
# DCGM
dcgmdiag -v
# basic k8s health
kubectl get nodes -o wide
kubectl -n redwood get pods -o wide | grep gpu
```

maria: ran driver checks: `nvidia-smi` shows driver 535.54, DCGM v2.6. No MIG profiles yet. nv_peer_mem module loaded.

maria: kubectl shows 6 nodes Ready with label `region=pdx1,gpu=true`, taints applied: `gpu=true:NoSchedule` ✅

jean: network checks: BGP session to cloud-peering established, flaps none in last 10m. MTU is 9000 on the transit link. Small ping test: avg 1.8ms inter-rack.

ashwin: Awesome. Next: smoke inference run. Use the sample loader (script in infra/tools) with a tiny model to validate KV cache and streaming.

maria: running smoke job now: `./infra/tools/smoke_infer.sh --model tiny-quant --concurrency 2 --requests 10`

ops-bot: smoke-runner started by maria at 1779990205 — job id smoke-1779990205

maria: smoke results: 10 requests completed, p50 42ms, p90 89ms, p99 210ms. No OOMs. Logs: one transient socket reconnect (handled by client) — marking as INFO.

taylor: I pulled metrics: token generation rate looks stable, but cache hit ratio low (15%) — probably because prefix caching not warmed. Recommend a warmup run with real-ish prompts.

ashwin: Good catch. Maria, do a 200-request warmup over 5 hosts to prefill KV cache, then remeasure p90.

maria: warmup done. Re-run smoke: p50 40ms, p90 72ms, p99 180ms. Cache hit ratio now 64%.

jean: infra logs: no OOM, kubelet restart on node-04 at 1779990330 (kubelet segfault due to cgroup v2 race) — node recovered automatically, but file an infra-ticket. Marking as WARN.

ashwin: Noted. That restart counts as a degradation event but within error budget for this bring-up. Add note to handoff: node-04 unstable -> replace in next maintenance window.

taylor: alerts check: Prometheus rules loaded, alertmanager contact set to paging on critical CPU/GPU OOM, latency breach alert at p95>250ms. All firing thresholds match the staged SLOs.

ops-bot: runbook checklist updated: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/pdx1-bringup — status: smoke-passed, network-ok, gpu-ok, infra-warn.

ashwin: Cost gating: initial capacity estimate (6 GPU nodes, 8 vCPU) projected monthly infra $12k. Product wants estimate with 2x headroom — add to PR.

maria: I'll prepare the handoff doc for readiness review: include known issues (kubelet restart, initial cache miss), perf numbers, and run commands for oncall.

jean: For handoff: recommended canary policy: route 5% traffic to PDX1, monitor error budget for 2 hours, then 25% if stable. Also include a fallback region plan (sfo2) and emergency model downgrade steps.

ashwin: OK team — final step: readiness review scheduled 30m from now. Please react with :white_check_mark: when the item you owned is complete.

maria: :white_check_mark:
jean: :white_check_mark:
taylor: :white_check_mark:
ashwin: :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: readiness-review created (1779990452) — attendees: ashwin,maria,jean,taylor — calendar invite sent.

maria: Handoff doc link: https://docs.internal/pdx1-handoff (draft). Will push final before review.

ashwin: Thanks all — great work. We'll proceed to canary following the review and keep this thread as the canonical smoke log.
